lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₂GeCl₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 14-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Ge centers coordinated by four Cl neighbors, while Cs centers show eight Cl neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cs and Ge polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Cs polyhedra.
